title: A stored organometallic partner is proposed for later radical coupling
status_authority: Exact selected source bytes and scoped source reports are preserved. This incremental integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority, or practical advantage.
reported_status: The XH1 producer proposes storing a primary alkyl partner in an organometallic intermediate and coupling it later with a tertiary radical. The report is a mechanism proposal without measured transfer rates, a complete reactor/reset cycle, or physical validation.
scientific_scope_status: The proposal uses a chemically stored partner state to separate partner acquisition from a later coupling event.
